mission.goal: Provide a compliant one-click ChatBridge successor-chat handoff at ChatGPT conversation limits.
mission.workflow: Observe rendered chat, checkpoint, detect limit, open route-preserving successor, inject and optionally send a one-time restore capsule.
mission.data: Rendered message roles/text, source URL/title, bounded session capsule, transcript-free local summary.
mission.interface: Chrome/Edge Manifest V3 content script and background worker.
mission.stack: Vanilla JavaScript, Chrome Extensions APIs, Node built-in test runner.
mission.environment: chatgpt.com in Chromium browsers; local dependency-free validation.
mission.governance: Formation-gated, zero recurring cost, reversible, proof-state separated.
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid capsules; preserve native fallback; no provider mutation claims.
mission.testing: Static syntax, deterministic unit, failure-first, manifest and build-contract validation.
mission.deployment: Isolated GitHub branch; unpacked/browser-store deployment requires native readback.
mission.continuity: Canonical ChatBridge registry and adapter pointers plus project handoff files.

assumptions.stack: Manifest V3 is supported by current Chrome/Edge.
assumptions.runtime: Content scripts run on chatgpt.com; service worker can use storage and tabs.
assumptions.storage: Session storage for full capsules; local storage for transcript-free summaries.
assumptions.authentication: Existing signed-in ChatGPT browser session; extension uses no credentials.
assumptions.deployment: GitHub registration is separate from user-browser installation.

components.frontend: Injected accessible action, status chip, and options page.
components.backend: Manifest V3 service worker with validated messages and tab-bound transfer.
components.database: NOT_APPLICABLE: no database; Chrome storage is sufficient.
components.queue: Single pending transfer object with one-time consume semantics.
components.scheduler: MutationObserver plus debounced checkpoint timer; no background schedule.
components.cache: Session latest capsule and pending transfer.
components.authentication: NOT_APPLICABLE: no remote API; browser host permission only.

observability.health_checks: runtime settings and pending-transfer message responses
observability.structured_logs: bounded error responses and status chip
observability.audit_logs: local latest capsule summary without transcript

testing.integration: background/content contracts verified by syntax plus browser-canary checklist
testing.e2e_or_smoke: live signed-in ChatGPT warning-to-successor canary pending external browser trust boundary
testing.fixtures_mocks: deterministic warning strings, URLs, messages and thresholds
testing.failure_first: invalid notice, bounded transcript, native fallback, invalid capsule, composer timeout

run_commands: Load unpacked extension through browser extension management surface
deploy_commands: Publish isolated GitHub branch; browser deployment requires separate readback
delivery.debugging: Inspect extension service worker, content-script console, status chip, and pending session transfer.

watchman.blocked_capability: Native OpenAI host-button modification and browser installation are unavailable through current machine authority.
watchman.safe_substitute: Reversible Manifest V3 companion with native fallback and isolated deployment package.
watchman.closure_test: Signed-in browser canary with exact DOM and successor-chat readback.

continuity.idempotency: capsuleId plus tab-bound one-time pending transfer
continuity.checkpoints: debounced session capsule and transcript-free local summary
continuity.resume_conditions: matching successor tab and unconsumed transfer

proof.test_results: 4/4 JavaScript syntax checks, 5/5 deterministic Node tests, manifest JSON, build-contract JSON, MODISA validator, and secret/network primitive scan passed on 2026-08-14 UTC.
proof.semantic_verification: The exact screenshot warning matched the detector; source route preservation, transcript bounding, capsule truth controls, restore prompt, and pre-emption thresholds passed deterministic tests.
